The '''Copa del Rey 1916''' was the 16th staging of the [[Copa del Rey]], the [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Association football|football]] cup competition.

The competition started on 26 March 1916, and concluded on 7 May 1916, with the [[1916 Copa del Rey Final|final]], held at the [[Camp de la Indústria]] in [[Barcelona]], in which [[Athletic Bilbao]] lifted the trophy for the 7th time ever with a 4–0 victory over [[Real Madrid CF|Madrid FC]], with a [[hat-trick#Association football|hat-trick]] from [[Félix Zubizarreta]]. It was Athletic's third title in a row, thus gaining the right to keep the trophy. However, this tournament is best known for its [[El Clásico]] in the semi-finals which saw Madrid FC and [[FC Barcelona]] go head-to-head for the first time in 14 years in the competition's history, and the two sides were only separated after four thrilling matches including a dramatic 6–6 draw with [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra-time]] and [[hat-trick#Association football|hat-tricks]] from the likes of [[Santiago Bernabéu Yeste|Bernabéu]] and [[Paulino Alcántara|Alcántara]].<ref name=Clásico>{{cite web |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/2096388/eighteenth-different-clasico-venue |title=Eighteenth different Clásico venue |website=www.fcbarcelona.com |access-date=7 April 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancup1916.html |title=Spain - Cup 1916 |date=20 January 2000 |website=[[RSSSF]] |accessdate=17 August 2022 }}</ref>

==Teams==
* '''[[Biscay Championship|North Region]]''': [[Athletic Bilbao]]
* '''[[Campeonato Regional Centro|Centre Region]]''': [[Real Madrid CF|Madrid FC]]
* '''[[Campeonato Regional Sur|South Region]]''': [[Español de Cádiz]]
* '''[[Campionato Gallego|Galicia Region]]''': [[Real Club Fortuna de Vigo|Fortuna de Vigo]]
* '''[[Catalan football championship|Catalonia Region]]''': [[FC Barcelona]]

[[Real Club Fortuna de Vigo|Fortuna de Vigo]] (Champions of Galicia) and [[Español de Cádiz]] (Champions of Andalusia) withdrew before the draw.
